svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Noto Sans', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Rotate keeps the slot; revoke removes it
svg.desc: The local Zenoh router's access list is static and default-deny, with four slots cut into it before anyone joins, each a write grant keyed on a certificate common name equal to the slot's anchor. weather-vane is rotated to a fresh leaf with the same anchor, so the access list does not change and it keeps publishing; loud-mouth is revoked by removing its slot's grant, so its writes are denied; steady-eddie publishes throughout; the fourth slot is free.
svg.text: Rotate keeps the slot; revoke removes it
The router's access list is static. Its grants follow a slot anchor, never a certificate.
Zenoh router: default-deny access list, four slots cut in before anyone joins
